title: Freelancer vs Agency for a Local Business Website

cover.alt: A small shop model sits between a single builder's tool station and three coordinated specialist stations.

figures.title: Match the working structure to the job
figures.summary: Compare the same needs on both sides before choosing a provider.

items.label: Scope
items.detail: Freelancer: one coordinated build. Agency: several specialized workstreams.

items.label: Communication
items.detail: Freelancer: direct builder contact. Agency: a named project or account contact.

items.label: Marketing
items.detail: Freelancer: foundation or advice. Agency: capacity for ongoing specialist campaigns.

items.label: Brand work
items.detail: Freelancer: confirm the designer's capabilities. Agency: confirm the proposed brand team's role.

figures.caption: The article's qualitative comparison. Verify the actual provider's scope and capabilities rather than inferring them from a label.

figures.title: Checks that apply to either choice
figures.summary: The provider's structure does not replace practical due diligence.

items.label: Live work
items.detail: Visit completed websites and try them on a phone.

items.label: References
items.detail: Ask previous clients about delivery and communication.

items.label: Written scope
items.detail: Read what is included, excluded and billed separately.

items.label: Ownership
items.detail: Confirm control of the domain, hosting, content and source.

items.label: After launch
items.detail: Clarify how changes, maintenance and support are handled.

figures.caption: A shared hiring checklist drawn from the article, without repeating its illustrative price ranges as current quotes.
